name: @ship/shared
description: Ship Shared pack — internal, RUNTIME-FREE ship-* components reused across Ship's own first-party apps (hub, spaces). INTERNAL, not a published domain pack. Components are purely presentational: they take data + permissions as PROPS and the consuming app (which owns the runtime) supplies them. Nothing here may import @ship/sail-runtime, @ship/sdk(-client), or the contract — enforced by `bun run guard`. Presentational atoms compose @ship/sail-primitives; the host owns the data wire and registers @ship/sail-primitives for any composed tag.
